title: Improving the Image
text: Rabbit Guy silently offered up his arm, then his shoulder, then his back in turn, presenting whatever part he wanted petted next. I thought this was quite efficient of him, but I was also impressed he could do it so deliberately. Father, smiling all the while, obliged Rabbit Guy’s requests one by one. And then, as if the natural conclusion, Rabbit Guy spread his arms wide for a hug.
“Iwatani-sama.”
“Yeah, yeah. Theo wanted one of these too, huh?”

When they hugged, Father sank a little into Rabbit Guy’s fluffy fur with a satisfying poof. After a moment, Rabbit Guy seemed satisfied and pulled away. In my mind’s eye, I could practically feel Big Sister and the others watching with envious stares. Though the Big Sister from the loop where she’d been reunited with Fleon-chan was different—still in her Raph-species Beastman form, she had her eyes closed, seemingly unaffected. After all, she was the Big Sister who had already been thoroughly moffed by Father to her heart’s content. Surely the most-petted Big Sister of them all. Meanwhile, Raph-chan, representative of the Raph-species, and Raph-chan seemed to be lying down in front of Father as if refusing to lose out.
“Iwatani-sama is very good at petting.”
“Next time I’ll give you a proper brushing. If you’re going to be in that form more often from now on, I’ll need to take care of your coat too.”
“Yes. I’ll do my best. I look forward to it.”
“Right. Now, something I’m curious about—Theo, has this form given you any new abilities? Did your physical stats go up?”
“I don’t know. All I’ve noticed is that I’m fluffier and my eye level is higher.”
“That’d be a shame if it were just cosmetic. We should check properly to see if there’s an actual difference.”
“Voff.”
Wolf barked in agreement with Father’s words, I say.

“Well… I don’t know, just going by appearances, since Theo’s a rabbit Beastman, I’d guess magic might come more naturally to him. But who knows. Is it fixed which stats go up depending on the type of Beastman transformation? Lars-chan, do you know?”
“Hah? Wouldn’t it make more sense to ask the Siltvelt nobility and their attendant instead of a mere mercenary like me? Don’t go throwing questions my way just because I look bored.”
Panda scratched her belly irritably, grumbling out her reply.
“That varies by species. It’s true that transforming does consume mana, but it’s also true that in some cases it simply raises magical power output.”

“I see, I see. So which type is Theo, I wonder? Is it going to be a big boost to physical stats, or more of a magic-power type? His stat growth seems like the late-bloomer type, honestly. He’s been improving a lot lately.”

“This person here drastically boosted my endurance, though. Even during the whipping segment of the show, when someone other than Iwatani-sama does it, I barely feel any pain now, which makes it hard to act like it hurts.”
Ah yes, that would be the reinforcement I did so he could withstand getting kicked by Filo-tan without trouble.
“Well, either way, good for you for working hard at it. If that means you’ve overcome all your bodily pain, that’s the best outcome, as far as I’m concerned.”
“……Honestly, I haven’t really felt pain in a long while now. It’s all thanks to you, Iwatani-sama.”
Rabbit Guy answered Father with eyes full of deep affection.
Maintain that fluffiness, Rabbit Guy! Uphold the cause of rabbit cuteness with all your might, indeed.
Under no circumstances should you make faces or gestures that would damage the image of rabbits everywhere.
“It’s vital to rub your face for absolutely no reason sometimes. A fine way to appeal to Father, I say.”
“Washing my face for no reason, you mean…”
Rabbit Guy reluctantly rubbed at his face. Oh ho… he even struck a little praying pose. Quite the performer.
“Voff.”
Not to be outdone, Wolf scratched his ear with his foot and rolled over onto his side. That’s clearly an appeal for petting! You there! Do you still crave Father’s attention!?
“What is this scene…? Wolf, I get that you want affection, but think about your age.”
“Wow-?”
“If you keep this up, you’re going to lose all your dignity and gravitas, you know?”
“Sometimes even Wolf wants to be spoiled, Naofumi-sama.”

How crafty of you, Wolf, but that approach only backfires with Father. Heh… someday I shall teach you the ultimate technique of being spoiled by Father—the secret art passed down directly from Chick herself!
“Iwatani-sama, is there an outfit that would suit me in this form? I’d love to try wearing something you picked out, whether for circus performances or everyday life.”
“Huh? Let’s see… something that’d suit you… maybe a big pocket watch? A monocle might look good on you too, Theo.”

Oh ho… a pocket watch would suit him, would it? Very informative. Then perhaps a pocket-watch-style pouch would go nicely on him during his Usaunny appearances too. Suddenly, a memory floated up in my mind—that time we performed Alice in Wonderland with the pigs.
“Alice in Wonderland, indeed!”
“Ah, Motoyasu-kun figured it out, huh?”
“What is it?” Rabbit Guy asked, sounding curious.
“There’s clearly a source for the idea. If he’s going to cosplay, wouldn’t it be better to just tell him outright?”
“Rafumi-chan probably… already knows. Well, it’s a character from a certain story.”
“I believe I’ve heard of that one—it comes up in Siltvelt whenever the topic turns to Heroes and species that look like Theodore-sama does now.”
The Siltvelt envoy said so, and Wolf nodded along too.
“I bet the past Shield Heroes have talked about all sorts of animal characters from stories they know.”
“That’s largely accurate. Sharing such stories tends to be well received by the various species.”
“Voff, my species is often the villain.”
“It’s true wolves tend to get cast as villains a lot, but there are plenty of cool stories about them too, you know.”
“I’d be delighted if you could tell me, Iwatani-sama, about a character that might suit me.”
“Sure, let’s see… I suppose I might as well tell you.”

And so, Father told Rabbit Guy the tale of the rabbit from Alice in Wonderland. Though, to be fair, after leading Alice into Wonderland, that rabbit doesn’t really do much of note. If anything, he’s more on the enemy side of things. Father explained all this rather gently. But still… even if Rabbit Guy ends up cosplaying as that rabbit, I decided I’d have Father watch me in my Usaunny costume too. And right about then, in my mind, I imagined the reaction of the Father and company from the loop where I hadn’t been able to save them from that false accusation, seeing me in Usaunny form cosplaying as the rabbit from Alice in Wonderland.
‘Well, you certainly are a rabbit. No doubt about it—a proper March Hare.’

Ehehe… indeed. In Alice in Wonderland, there’s also the March Hare, after all. Now I’m torn over which rabbit to show him. Preparing this costume too seems like a fine idea. Though, what exactly did that comment mean? I’ll have to ask Father when I make my debut in it.
“Something like this, I’d guess.”
Rafumi snapped her fingers, and Rabbit Guy’s clothes appeared to shift into the outfit Father had described. An illusion spell to make it look the part, I see.
“Yeah, yeah, something like that would suit you well.”
“Then I’ll go with a rather intelligent-looking rabbit. Fufu, this is starting to sound fun. Though… it does resemble a slave trader’s outfit somewhat.”
“Ah… well, that guy’s sort of in that line of work, yeah.”

Rabbit Guy listened to his conversation with Father with obvious delight. In any case, the important thing was devoting himself fully to improving the image of rabbits! And so, Rabbit Guy’s worries were resolved.
